description: This Swift source file defines a singleton class 'DockIconManager' responsible for managing the visibility of the application's Dock icon in macOS. It observes window events and user defaults to dynamically show or hide the Dock icon depending on window visibility and user preferences.

classes.name: DockIconManager
classes.description: A final singleton class that manages the show's application's Dock icon based on window visibility and user preferences.

methods.name: updateDockVisibility
methods.description: Checks window visibility and user preferences to set the application's activation policy, thus showing or hiding the Dock icon.

methods.name: temporarilyShowDock
methods.description: Temporarily sets the application to a visible Dock icon state.

methods.name: setupObservers
methods.description: Sets up observations for window changes and UserDefaults changes, to reactively update docking behavior.

methods.name: windowVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when window visibility-related notifications are received; triggers an update of the Dock visibility.

methods.name: dockPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when user defaults related to Dock visibility change; triggers an update of the Dock visibility.

methods.name: shared
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DockIconManager.
